> Built by a Salafi brother for the sake of Allah, for Muslims who fear Allah and want to download lessons of the mashāyikh and beneficial clips that help them worship Allah and draw closer to Him. So fear Allah in how you use it. Most haram websites are blocked anyway.
>
> صنعه أخٌ سلفي ابتغاءَ وجه الله، للمسلمين الذين يخشون الله ويريدون تحميل دروس المشايخ والمقاطع النافعة التي تعينهم على عبادة الله والتقرّب إليه. فاتّقِ الله في استخدامه، وقد حُجبت أكثر المواقع المحرّمة على كل حال.

## Release files

#### Recommended

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| [Haseed-macOS.zip](https://github.com/AbuGha1th/haseed/releases/latest/download/Haseed-macOS.zip) | macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon). Unzip, then double-click `start.command`. Needs [Python 3](https://www.python.org/downloads/) |
| [Haseed-Windows.zip](https://github.com/AbuGha1th/haseed/releases/latest/download/Haseed-Windows.zip) | Windows 10 and 11. Unzip, then double-click `start.bat`. Needs [Python 3](https://www.python.org/downloads/) |
| [Haseed-Android.apk](https://github.com/AbuGha1th/haseed/releases/latest/download/Haseed-Android.apk) | Android 8 or newer, 64-bit phones. Everything is inside, no computer needed |

#### Misc

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| [SHA2-256SUMS](https://github.com/AbuGha1th/haseed/releases/latest/download/SHA2-256SUMS) | SHA-256 checksums of the files above |

**iPhone:** there is no iPhone app. Run Haseed on a Mac or Windows computer and use it from Safari on your iPhone (see [Use it from your phone](https://github.com/AbuGha1th/haseed#use-it-from-your-phone-iphone-or-android)).

**Installing the Android app:** download the .apk on the phone and open it. Android asks you to allow installing apps from your browser or Files app the first time. Haseed is not on the Play Store, because Google does not allow apps that download from YouTube.
